nodes.description: Public string token name, written in constructor.
Public string token symbol, written in constructor.
Public uint8 token decimals, set to 18 in constructor.
Public total supply of SFT tokens, read by totalSupply().
Mapping of holder address to token balance; core storage for transfers.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount allowance storage.
Constructor mints the entire supply to msg.sender and emits Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using unchecked subtraction.
Returns the token balance of the given owner.
Returns the remaining allowance for spender on tokenOwner funds.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] to tokens, overwriting prior allowance without check.
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' debiting allowed[from][msg.sender] with no explicit allowance sufficiency check.
Library addition with overflow guard (c >= a).
Library subtraction with underflow guard (b <= a).
Library multiplication with overflow guard.
Library division with zero-divisor guard.
Caller-controlled address used as owner/spender in approve, transfer and transferFrom.
Raw subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply() outside SafeMath.
transferFrom debits allowance via safeSub without verifying allowance >= tokens before state mutation.
approve unconditionally overwrites the existing allowance, exposing the classic approve race condition.

edges.reason: spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping written by approve.
tokens parameter is stored into allowed during approve.
to parameter receives the credited balance in transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount debited/credited in transfer.
from parameter is the account debited by transferFrom without allowance ownership proof.
to parameter receives the credited balance in transferFrom.
tokens parameter directly controls how much allowance and balance are consumed.
tokenOwner parameter indexes balances read by balanceOf.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the outer allowed mapping read by allowance.
spender parameter indexes the inner allowed mapping read by allowance.
msg.sender receives the entire initial supply in the constructor.
msg.sender is used as the owner key when setting its own allowance.
msg.sender balance is debited in transfer.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is consumed, trusting the caller-supplied 'from'.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transfer mutates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping for from and to.
transferFrom mutates allowed[from][msg.sender] before validating sufficiency.
transfer relies on safeSub for balance debiting.
transfer relies on safeAdd for balance crediting.
transferFrom relies on safeSub for balance and allowance debiting.
transferFrom relies on safeAdd for balance crediting.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] which feeds an unchecked subtraction.
The unchecked subtraction operation is reachable from totalSupply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
Constructor assigns _totalSupply.
Constructor assigns the minted balance.
Constructor assigns the token name.
Constructor assigns the token symbol.
Constructor assigns the decimals value.
approve performs an unconditional allowance overwrite reachable from its body.
transferFrom reaches the missing-allowance-check unsafe operation.
msg.sender controls which allowance entry transferFrom consumes.
msg.sender controls the allowance slot overwritten by approve.

normalization_plan.reason: approve.spender is only an indexing argument of the approve function; fold it into approve.
approve.tokens is only an assignment value in approve; fold it into approve.
transfer.to only identifies the credited balance slot in transfer; fold it into transfer.
transfer.tokens is only the arithmetic amount in transfer; fold it into transfer.
transferFrom.from only selects the debited balance key; fold it into transferFrom.
transferFrom.to only selects the credited balance key; fold it into transferFrom.
transferFrom.tokens is only the debited amount feeding safeSub; fold it into transferFrom.
balanceOf.tokenOwner is only a read index for balances; fold it into balanceOf.
allowance.tokenOwner is only a read index for the outer allowed mapping; fold it into allowance.
allowance.spender is only a read index for the inner allowed mapping; fold it into allowance.
